items.item_text: Earned terminal degree in Environmental Studies, Environmental Science, Biology, or other fields closely related to the environmental studies/sciences. Candidates who are ABD will be considered; completion of the terminal degree is required for continued employment.
Teaching skills and experience to support an ethnically and culturally diverse student body.

Teaching and research experience that could qualify a candidate for the AIMS Chair in Science with responsibilities that would include: Engaging the AIMS Foundation and serve as a liaison from the University on related projects and programs that advance science education. A candidate appointed to the AIMS Chair in Science will be oriented towards developing science teachers for Central Valley schools and beyond.

This position functions indoors in classroom, indoor laboratory, and an office environment with light to moderate noise associated with lab equipment and business office equipment. In addition, outdoor activities such as hiking and camping will be required at times as part of laboratory/field experiences for the academic programs. The position may involve teaching online, on-site at a main campus or at regional campuses, travel for meetings and events.

Teach courses related to Environmental Science (e.g. Ecology, General Biology: Diversity and Ecology, including associated laboratories) and/or Environmental Studies (e.g., Environmental Policy, Law, Economics and Justice) based on qualifications and teaching experience.

Provide leadership in the continued growth and development of the Environmental Science and Environmental Studies programs, including curriculum development, integration with the university's Wilderness Studies program, initiatives to enhance program visibility, develop community connections, and attract prospective students.
Teach additional biology and/or related courses consistent with departmental needs, qualifications, and teaching experience.
Maintain an active scholarly agenda, including opportunities to engage and mentor undergraduate students in research.
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students in an academic context that integrates your Christian faith and learning.

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea ”
Other job duties as assigned
Demonstrated effectiveness or strong potential for excellence in undergraduate teaching instruction and student mentorship.
Demonstrated record of scholarly achievement.
Participate in departmental and university meetings, activities, and areas of service.
Engaging the AIMS Foundation and serve as a liaison from the University on related projects and programs that advance science education.
A candidate appointed to the AIMS Chair in Science will be oriented towards developing science teachers for Central Valley schools and beyond.

Indoors in a normal classroom, indoor laboratory, and office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, fumes, vibrations, and temperature changes at least eighty percent (80%) of the time.
Frequent computer use at a workstation.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Drive personal or University vehicles to appointments.
Public contact position requiring professional apparel, personal hygiene, and grooming.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Ability to collaborate effectively with students, faculty, and staff in a collegial academic environment.
Ability to effectively engage the dialogue of faith and environmental studies/science, with faithfulness to disciplinary evidence and conversance in a range of Christian faith traditions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: remain in a stationary position up to 80% of the time; be able to move about inside the classroom and laboratory to talk to students, inside the office to access file cabinets/office machinery, etc.; operate a computer and keyboard and other office productivity machinery such as calculators/copy machines/printers. The employee is occasionally required to position self to reach items on the floor and in high cabinetry.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
